decision_rules: If row estimates diverge sharply from actual rows, inspect stale statistics.
anti_patterns: Avoid adding overlapping indexes without calculating write amplification.
Do not change the query text and the index strategy at the same time.
verification: Verify the fix by comparing latency, buffer hits, and row estimates before and after the change.
